$comment: Held-out WHOLE-TYPE plugin eval intents (feature plugin-registration). Sibling of eval-set.json (the fragment held-out set) so the delegate schema + fixture.ts stay untouched. NEVER add these intents to a training set - they are the measurement. Plugin drafts are scored COMPILE-ONLY via POST /plugins/{category}/validate: the /subgraph element-set trick (fixture.ts) compares filter lambdas over a seeded graph and does not apply to whole types. `reference` is a known-good compiling source kept for documentation/parity; scoring runs the model's own output through the validator. `contract` is present only for algorithm rows.
